name: Kriemhild Lebenstein
original_name: クリームヒルト・レーベンシュタイン
source: She is the third Rosei after Amakasu Masahiko and Hiiragi Shishihachi . Nicknamed "Death God," she is the worst Rosei and is said to have been in conflict with Hiiragi Shishihachi.
translation: She is the third Rosei after Amakasu Masahiko and Hiiragi Shishihachi . Nicknamed "Death God," she is the worst Rosei and is said to have been in conflict with Hiiragi Shishihachi.
